betterhardcore.mode.softcore.line1: Start with 3 hearts; gain ½ heart every 30 min, up to 15.
betterhardcore.mode.softcore.line2: Each death removes 1 max heart; at 1 heart, Game Over is permanent.
betterhardcore.mode.softcore.description: Start with 3 hearts and gain half a heart every 30 minutes of survival, up to 15. Each death reduces your maximum health by 1 heart. Dying with only 1 heart results in a permanent Game Over.
